arguments.sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT order_id, customer_id
    FROM main.olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
),
items AS (
    SELECT d.order_id, d.customer_id, i.seller_id, i.price, i.freight_value
    FROM delivered AS d
    JOIN main.olist_order_items AS i ON i.order_id = d.order_id
),
seller_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT seller_id, order_id FROM items
),
five_star AS (
    SELECT so.seller_id, so.order_id, r.review_id
    FROM seller_orders AS so
    JOIN main.olist_order_reviews AS r ON r.order_id = so.order_id
    WHERE r.review_score = 5
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered) AS delivered_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM delivered) AS delivered_order_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items) AS item_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = items.customer_id) AS matched_customer_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE seller_id IS NULL OR price IS NULL OR freight_value IS NULL) AS incomplete_items,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE price <> ROUND(price, 2) OR freight_value <> ROUND(freight_value, 2)) AS subcent_items,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seller_orders) AS seller_order_pairs,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM five_star) AS seller_rating_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT seller_id, order_id, review_id FROM five_star)) AS seller_order_rating_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT seller_id, review_id FROM five_star)) AS seller_rating_ids

arguments.sql:
WITH delivered_items AS (
    SELECT i.seller_id, i.order_id, o.customer_id,
           i.price - i.freight_value AS item_profit
    FROM main.olist_order_items AS i
    JOIN main.olist_orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
seller_totals AS (
    SELECT i.seller_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customer_count,
           ROUND(SUM(i.item_profit), 2) AS profit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM delivered_items AS i
    LEFT JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
    GROUP BY i.seller_id
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category, 'Most unique customers' AS achievement,
           seller_id, customer_count AS value
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Highest total profit', seller_id, profit
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Most distinct delivered orders', seller_id, order_count
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Most 5-star ratings', i.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.review_id)
    FROM delivered_items AS i
    JOIN main.olist_order_reviews AS r ON r.order_id = i.order_id
    WHERE r.review_score = 5
    GROUP BY i.seller_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category, achievement, seller_id, value,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY value DESC) AS place
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT achievement, seller_id, value
FROM ranked
WHERE place = 1
ORDER BY category, seller_id
